brief: Holds the four best-practice rules of a business process and judges a workflow against them.
detail: The set, named BPM Best Practices in the bpm domain, carries bpm_no_orphans (a step with no connection in or out), bpm_single_start (exactly one start), bpm_decision_branches (a decision has at least two ways out) and bpm_assignment_required (a step is assigned to an actor), each of severity error. Check(oWorkflow) answers the findings in the house shape and IsSound answers whether none is an error.
receiver:
oWf = new stzWorkflow("order")
oWf.AddStepXT("receive", "Receive order")
oWf.AddStepXT("pack", "Pack")
oWf.AddStepXT("lone", "Lone")
oWf.ConnectSteps("receive", "pack")
